name: @promopilot/og-debugger
description: Debug Open Graph and Twitter Card tags from the command line: fetches the page as the Facebook crawler, shows the Facebook, LinkedIn and X previews with fallbacks, and checks the share image (format, 1200x630 size, ratio, weight), og:url vs canonical and missing tags. Zero-dependency Node.js CLI, library and GitHub Action. Free online version by PromoPilot.
author: Alexandr Krikun (https://github.com/ksanyok)
